description: Find out where an audience is and the ways to bring it in. Without source: questions to ask the person (where their people are, which group, what they can sign in to, whether consent was recorded, once or kept in sync) and the kinds of source known. With source (their words, e.g. "Mixpanel", "Shopify", "our Postgres users table", "a Google Sheet"): the ways in, best first, each with steps and a console link: an integration already syncing it, another connected tool that can read it, a 6-hourly sync connected with their key here or in the console, a push to an ingest URL, a script with a key from their environment, an export, or a CSV upload. Changes nothing.

source.description: Where the people are, in your words. Omit to get the questions first.
